query: What was the gross profit margin for last month?
baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH last_month_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.Id AS OrderId,
        o.OrderTotal,
        o.OrderSubtotalExclTax,
        o.CreatedOnUtc
    FROM `Order` o
    WHERE o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01')
        AND o.CreatedOnUtc < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')
        AND o.Deleted = 0
        AND o.OrderStatusId IN (30, 40) -- Complete and Shipped orders only
),
order_items_with_cost AS (
    SELECT 
        lmo.OrderId,
        oi.Id AS OrderItemId,
        oi.Quantity,
        oi.UnitPriceExclTax,
        oi.PriceExclTax,
        p.Id AS ProductId,
        p.ProductCost,
        (oi.Quantity * p.ProductCost) AS TotalProductCost
    FROM last_month_orders lmo
    INNER JOIN OrderItem oi ON lmo.OrderId = oi.OrderId
    INNER JOIN Product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
    WHERE oi.Deleted = 0
),
order_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        OrderId,
        SUM(PriceExclTax) AS TotalRevenueExclTax,
        SUM(TotalProductCost) AS TotalCostOfGoodsSold
    FROM order_items_with_cost
    GROUP BY OrderId
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (SUM(TotalRevenueExclTax) - SUM(TotalCostOfGoodsSold)) / SUM(TotalRevenueExclTax) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS GrossProfitMarginPercent,
    ROUND(SUM(TotalRevenueExclTax) - SUM(TotalCostOfGoodsSold), 2) AS GrossProfitAmount,

FROM order_summary;
```

query: Which 10 products have the highest profit margin this month?

```sql
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.ProductId,
        p.Name AS ProductName,
        SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax - oi.UnitCost) * oi.Quantity AS TotalProfit,
        SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity) AS TotalRevenue,
        SUM((oi.UnitPriceInclTax - oi.UnitCost) * oi.Quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity), 0) * 100 AS ProfitMarginPercent
    FROM `OrderItem` oi
    INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
    INNER JOIN `Product` p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
    WHERE o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')

      AND o.OrderStatusId = 30 -- Complete order status
    GROUP BY oi.ProductId, p.Name
)
SELECT 
    ProductId,
    ProductName,
    ROUND(TotalProfit, 2) AS TotalProfit,
    ROUND(TotalRevenue, 2) AS TotalRevenue,
    ROUND(ProfitMarginPercent, 2) AS ProfitMarginPercent
FROM monthly_sales
WHERE ProfitMarginPercent IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ProfitMarginPercent DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

```sql
    INNER JOIN nop_ProductCategory pc ON p.Id = pc.ProductId

department_returns AS (
```

```sql
-- Comparative summary of sales, returns, and net profit for each sales channel
-- Assumptions:
-- - Sales channel determined by Order.ChannelId or Order.StoreId mapping
-- - Returns identified by OrderItem.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL or OrderItem.QuantityReturned > 0
-- - Net profit = (OrderItem.UnitPriceInclTax * (OrderItem.Quantity - OrderItem.QuantityReturned)) 
--   - (OrderItem.UnitPriceExclTax * (OrderItem.Quantity - OrderItem.QuantityReturned)) 
--   - shipping costs - payment fees, etc. (simplified)
-- - If ChannelId not present, use StoreId/Store.StoreType or a custom channel mapping

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN o.ChannelId = 1 THEN 'Online Store'
        WHEN o.ChannelId = 2 THEN 'Mobile App'
        WHEN o.ChannelId = 3 THEN 'Marketplace'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS sales_channel,
    
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(oi.Quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity) AS gross_sales_amount,
    
    -- Returns: units returned and refunded amount
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
        THEN oi.QuantityReturned 
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS total_units_returned,
    
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
        THEN (oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.QuantityReturned) 
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS total_refund_amount,
    
    -- Net sales (gross - refunds)
    SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity) - 
    SUM(CASE 
        WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
        THEN (oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.QuantityReturned) 
        ELSE 0 
    END) AS net_sales_amount,
    
    -- Cost of goods sold (using unit price excl tax as cost basis - simplified)
    SUM(oi.UnitPriceExclTax * (oi.Quantity - 
        CASE 
            WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
            THEN oi.QuantityReturned 
            ELSE 0 
        END)) AS total_cogs,
    
    -- Net profit (net sales - cogs - shipping - fees)
    (SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity) - 
     SUM(CASE 
         WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
         THEN (oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.QuantityReturned) 
         ELSE 0 
     END)) 
     - SUM(oi.UnitPriceExclTax * (oi.Quantity - 
        CASE 
            WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
            THEN oi.QuantityReturned 
            ELSE 0 
        END))
     - COALESCE(SUM(o.ShippingCost), 0)
     - COALESCE(SUM(o.PaymentFee), 0) AS net_profit,
    
    -- Profit margin percentage
    ROUND(
        ((SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity) - 
          SUM(CASE 
              WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
              THEN (oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.QuantityReturned) 
              ELSE 0 
          END)) 
          - SUM(oi.UnitPriceExclTax * (oi.Quantity - 
             CASE 
                 WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
                 THEN oi.QuantityReturned 
                 ELSE 0 
             END))
          - COALESCE(SUM(o.ShippingCost), 0)
          - COALESCE(SUM(o.PaymentFee), 0)
        ) / NULLIF(
            (SUM(oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.Quantity) - 
             SUM(CASE 
                 WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
                 THEN (oi.UnitPriceInclTax * oi.QuantityReturned) 
                 ELSE 0 
             END)), 0) * 100, 2
    ) AS profit_margin_percent,
    
    -- Return rate
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN oi.ReturnRequestId IS NOT NULL OR oi.QuantityReturned > 0 
            THEN oi.QuantityReturned 
            ELSE 0 
        END) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.Quantity), 0) * 100, 2
    ) AS return_rate_percent

FROM 
    `Order` o
INNER JOIN 
    `OrderItem` oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
INNER JOIN

LEFT JOIN 
    `Customer` c ON o.CustomerId = c.Id
LEFT JOIN

    AND o.OrderStatusId IN (10, 20, 30, 40) -- Pending, Processing, Complete, Shipped
    AND o.PaymentStatusId IN (10, 20, 30, 40) -- Paid, Authorized, etc.
```

query: Which 4 product attributes (e.g., material, brand) correlate most strongly with higher margins?
baseline_sql:
```sql
WITH product_margins AS (
    SELECT 
        p.Id AS product_id,
        p.Name AS product_name,
        p.Price,
        p.ProductCost,
        (p.Price - p.ProductCost) / NULLIF(p.Price, 0) AS margin_rate,
        -- Extract product attributes from the SpecificationAttribute table
        -- Assumes attributes are stored as specifications
        sa.Name AS attribute_name,
        sps.SpecificationAttributeOptionId,
        sao.Name AS attribute_value
    FROM Product p
    LEFT JOIN Product_SpecificationAttribute_Mapping psam ON p.Id = psam.ProductId
    LEFT JOIN SpecificationAttributeOption sao ON psam.SpecificationAttributeOptionId = sao.Id
    LEFT JOIN SpecificationAttribute sa ON sao.SpecificationAttributeId = sa.Id
    WHERE p.Price > 0 
      AND p.ProductCost IS NOT NULL 
      AND p.ProductCost > 0
      AND p.Deleted = 0
      AND p.Published = 1
),

-- Calculate average margin rate for each attribute value
attr_value_margins AS (
    SELECT 
        attribute_name,
        attribute_value,
        COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS product_count,
        AVG(margin_rate) AS avg_margin_rate,
        STDDEV(margin_rate) AS margin_stddev
    FROM product_margins
    WHERE attribute_name IS NOT NULL 
      AND attribute_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY attribute_name, attribute_value
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) >= 5 -- Minimum sample size for statistical relevance
),

-- Calculate overall average margin for comparison
overall_avg_margin AS (
    SELECT AVG(margin_rate) AS overall_avg
    FROM product_margins
),

-- Calculate correlation-like metric: deviation from average, weighted by product count
attribute_correlation AS (
    SELECT 
        avm.attribute_name,
        avm.attribute_value,
        avm.product_count,
        avm.avg_margin_rate,
        (avm.avg_margin_rate - oa.overall_avg) AS margin_deviation,
        (avm.avg_margin_rate - oa.overall_avg) * avm.product_count / 
            NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM product_margins), 0) AS correlation_score
    FROM attr_value_margins avm
    CROSS JOIN overall_avg_margin oa
),

-- Rank attributes by their impact (highest positive deviation)
attribute_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        attribute_name,
        AVG(margin_deviation) AS avg_deviation,
        COUNT(DISTINCT attribute_value) AS distinct_values,
        SUM(product_count) AS total_products_covered,
        AVG(avg_margin_rate) AS avg_margin_for_attribute
    FROM attribute_correlation
    GROUP BY attribute_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT attribute_value) >= 2 -- Attribute must have multiple values
),

-- Get top 4 attributes with highest positive impact on margins
top_attributes AS (
    SELECT 
        attribute_name,
        avg_deviation,
        distinct_values,
        total_products_covered,
        avg_margin_for_attribute,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_deviation DESC) AS impact_rank
    FROM attribute_ranking
    WHERE avg_deviation > 0 -- Only positive correlation
    ORDER BY avg_deviation DESC
    LIMIT 4
)

-- Final output: top 4 attribute names with their correlation strength
SELECT 
    ta.attribute_name,
    ta.avg_deviation AS margin_increase_above_average,
    ta.avg_margin_for_attribute AS average_margin_for_attribute,
    ta.distinct_values AS number_of_values,
    ta.total_products_covered AS products_with_attribute,
    CASE 
        WHEN ta.impact_rank = 1 THEN 'Strongest'
        WHEN ta.impact_rank = 2 THEN 'Strong'
        WHEN ta.impact_rank = 3 THEN 'Moderate'
        WHEN ta.impact_rank = 4 THEN 'Moderate'
    END AS correlation_strength
FROM top_attributes ta
ORDER BY ta.avg_deviation DESC;

-- Alternative approach: Analyze product attributes from ProductAttribute (if using product variants)
-- This query handles attributes stored as product variant attributes (e.g., size, color)
WITH variant_margins AS (
    SELECT 
        p.Id AS product_id,
        p.Name AS product_name,
        p.Price AS base_price,
        p.ProductCost AS base_cost,
        pv.Id AS variant_id,
        pv.Price AS variant_price,
        pv.ProductCost AS variant_cost,
        COALESCE(pv.Price, p.Price) AS effective_price,
        COALESCE(pv.ProductCost, p.ProductCost) AS effective_cost,
        (COALESCE(pv.Price, p.Price) - COALESCE(pv.ProductCost, p.ProductCost)) / 
            NULLIF(COALESCE(pv.Price, p.Price), 0) AS variant_margin_rate,
        pva.ProductAttributeId,
        pa.Name AS attribute_name,
        pva.Value AS attribute_value
    FROM Product p
    LEFT JOIN ProductVariant pv ON p.Id = pv.ProductId
    LEFT JOIN ProductVariant_ProductAttribute_Mapping pvpam ON pv.Id = pvpam.ProductVariantId
    LEFT JOIN ProductAttribute pa ON pvpam.ProductAttributeId = pa.Id
    LEFT JOIN ProductVariantAttributeValue pvav ON pvpam.Id = pvav.ProductVariantAttributeMappingId
    LEFT JOIN ProductVariantAttributeValue pva ON pvpam.Id = pva.ProductVariantAttributeMappingId
    WHERE (p.Price > 0 OR pv.Price > 0)
      AND (p.ProductCost IS NOT NULL OR pv.ProductCost IS NOT NULL)
      AND (p.ProductCost > 0 OR pv.ProductCost > 0)
      AND p.Deleted = 0
      AND p.Published = 1
),

variant_attr_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        attribute_name,
        attribute_value,
        COUNT(DISTINCT variant_id) AS variant_count,
        AVG(variant_margin_rate) AS avg_variant_margin,
        STDDEV(variant_margin_rate) AS margin_variance
    FROM variant_margins
    WHERE attribute_name IS NOT NULL 
      AND attribute_value IS NOT NULL
      AND attribute_value != ''
    GROUP BY attribute_name, attribute_value
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT variant_id) >= 5
),

overall_variant_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(variant_margin_rate) AS overall_avg
    FROM variant_margins
),

variant_correlation AS (
    SELECT 
        vas.attribute_name,
        vas.attribute_value,
        vas.variant_count,
        vas.avg_variant_margin,
        (vas.avg_variant_margin - ova.overall_avg) AS margin_impact,
        (vas.avg_variant_margin - ova.overall_avg) * vas.variant_count / 
            NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT variant_id) FROM variant_margins), 0) AS weighted_impact
    FROM variant_attr_stats vas
    CROSS JOIN overall_variant_avg ova
),

variant_ranking AS (
```

```sql
        p.Id,
        p.Name,

        -- Define seasonal products based on category or manufacturer or product type
        -- Example: products from 'Summer Collection' category or created in specific months
        CASE 
            WHEN c.Name LIKE '%Summer%' THEN 'Summer'
            WHEN c.Name LIKE '%Winter%' THEN 'Winter'
            WHEN c.Name LIKE '%Spring%' THEN 'Spring'
            WHEN c.Name LIKE '%Fall%' THEN 'Fall'
            WHEN p.ProductTypeId = 10 THEN 'Seasonal' -- Custom seasonal product type
            ELSE NULL

    LEFT JOIN `ProductCategory` pc ON p.Id = pc.ProductId
    LEFT JOIN `Category` c ON pc.CategoryId = c.Id
    WHERE c.Name LIKE '%Summer%' 
        OR c.Name LIKE '%Winter%' 
        OR c.Name LIKE '%Spring%' 
        OR c.Name LIKE '%Fall%'
        OR p.ProductTypeId = 10
),
forecasted_sales AS (

        p.Id AS ProductId,

    FROM `OrderItem` oi
    INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id

    WHERE o.OrderStatusId = 30
        AND o.PaymentStatusId = 40
        AND YEAR(o.CreatedOnUtc) < YEAR(CURDATE())
        AND (c.Name LIKE '%Summer%' 
            OR c.Name LIKE '%Winter%' 
            OR c.Name LIKE '%Spring%' 
            OR c.Name LIKE '%Fall%'
            OR p.ProductTypeId = 10)
    GROUP BY p.Id
),
sales_comparison AS (

        sp.ProductId,
        sp.ProductName,
        sp.Season,
        COALESCE(ys.ActualSales, 0) AS ActualSales,
```

```sql
    SELECT 
        DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        SUM(o.OrderTotal) AS total_revenue

        AND o.CreatedOnUtc < DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01')
    GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.CreatedOnUtc, '%Y-%m')
),
monthly_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        total_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month DESC) AS rn_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month ASC) AS rn_asc,
        COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_months
    FROM monthly_revenue
),
linear_regression AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(rn_asc) AS x_mean,
        AVG(total_revenue) AS y_mean,
        SUM((rn_asc - AVG(rn_asc) OVER ()) * (total_revenue - AVG(total_revenue) OVER ())) / 
        SUM(POWER(rn_asc - AVG(rn_asc) OVER (), 2)) AS slope,
        AVG(total_revenue) - (SUM((rn_asc - AVG(rn_asc) OVER ()) * (total_revenue - AVG(total_revenue) OVER ())) / 
        SUM(POWER(rn_asc - AVG(rn_asc) OVER (), 2))) * AVG(rn_asc) AS intercept
    FROM monthly_revenue
),
next_month_index AS (
    SELECT MAX(rn_asc) + 1 AS next_idx
    FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT 
    'Next Month Forecast' AS forecast_period,
    DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS forecast_month,
    ROUND((lr.slope * nmi.next_idx + lr.intercept), 2) AS forecasted_revenue,
    ROUND((lr.slope * nmi.next_idx + lr.intercept) - 
        (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM monthly_revenue), 2) AS variance_from_avg,
    ROUND(
        ((lr.slope * nmi.next_idx + lr.intercept) - 
        (SELECT total_revenue FROM monthly_rank WHERE rn_desc = 1)) / 
        (SELECT total_revenue FROM monthly_rank WHERE rn_desc = 1) * 100, 2
    ) AS percent_change_from_last_month
FROM linear_regression lr
CROSS JOIN next_month_index nmi;
```
